title: Managing a Team Through Layoffs
paragraphs: Ketika pemutusan hubungan kerja seluruh perusahaan diumumkan, Firas, sebagai pemimpin tim, menghadapi tugas sulit menyampaikan berita itu kepada anggota timnya yang tersisa sambil mengelola ketidakpastiannya sendiri tentang masa depan.
Alih-alih berpura-pura semuanya baik-baik saja, ia mengakui kecemasan tim dengan jujur, mengakui kesulitan situasi itu sambil tetap transparan tentang apa yang ia ketahui dan belum ia ketahui.

Beberapa anggota tim kemudian menyebutkan bahwa kejujurannya, alih-alih penenangan palsu, membantu mereka mempercayai kepemimpinannya selama periode yang sangat tidak pasti dan penuh tekanan bagi seluruh departemen.

Firas merenungkan setelahnya bahwa memimpin melewati kesulitan yang nyata membutuhkan lebih banyak kejujuran daripada kepercayaan diri, dan berpura-pura pasti di masa tidak pasti seringkali merusak kepercayaan lebih daripada mengakui kebenaran.
answerKey: When company-wide layoffs were announced, Firas, as a team leader, faced the difficult task of communicating the news to his remaining team members while managing his own uncertainty about the future. Rather than pretending everything was fine, he addressed the team's anxiety honestly, acknowledging the difficulty of the situation while being transparent about what he knew and did not yet know. Several team members later mentioned that his honesty, rather than false reassurance, helped them trust his leadership during an otherwise deeply uncertain and stressful period for the whole department. Firas reflected afterward that leading through genuine difficulty required more honesty than confidence, and that pretending certainty during uncertain times often damaged trust more than admitting the truth.
